newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian firm launches website for equities.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian firm launches website for equities.

text.p: Indonesia Net Exchange said on Thursday it had launched the country's first Internet website devoted to providing information on local listed companies and developments in capital markets.

"Indoexchange has been established in response to the growing popularity of Indonesia investments around the world and demand for more up-to-date information about economic and political developments in the country," director Scott Coffey told Reuters.

Indoexchange, located at http://www.indoexchange.com, offers information on listed local companies, instant updates of financial news and company reports, and news from Indonesia's official Antara news agency, he said.
Indoexchange also provides information and analysis on various industries in conjunction with one of the country's largest business research data providers, DataConsult, director Eddie Darajat said.
The firm is offering the information in conjunction with the country's capital market supervisory agency (Bapepam) and the Jakarta Stock Exchange, he said.
Darajat said the site offered quotes on stocks that were the most active and made strong gains, but that they were delayed by about 30 minutes due to infrastructure problems.
